changes.change: OmicStat CLI/module/schema/arg spec, labels, required scientific choices, StudyContract, typed candidate handoff, SHA256 provenance and shared rendering. No MedStat runtime, journal theme, clinical report templates or automatic installer.

Original automatic psych::ICC estimator fallback removed. Missing irr fails. Explicit model/definition/unit/population/same-rater declarations replace auto selection. One-way requires random raters; fixed agreement rationale cannot be blank. This is a reviewable adaptation, not demonstrated numerical equivalence.
Original formula-only availability fallback removed for binary sensitivity companions. epiR must actually run; native errors do not become a synthetic package result.

Named original package arguments for suite registry checks: vcd x, irr ratings/model/type/unit/r0/conf.level, Fleiss exact/detail, epiR dat/method/alternative/conf.level. Current CRAN documentation checked only for names; installed versions/defaults unverified.

No subject-row expansion for analytic counted tables. Counts outside exact integer range and bootstrap expansion above one million units refuse OS_RESOURCE_LIMIT without subsampling or CI-method changes. Categories outside declared levels refuse even on zero-count cells.

Map registered MS errors to OS, AG QC to unused OAG. Copy five non-QBA QC helpers; preserve original numeric threshold conditions and five warning overrides. QBA14-16 excluded. Clinical reader-report audit is replaced by suite surfaces and remains separately unvalidated.

Preserve original estimate-inside-CI/count/estimand guard, including bootstrap. Compare table values with canonical native object before finish and again at renderer; point estimates are never clipped or substituted.

Preserve three original published example identities and 30 expected quantity checks using external normalized input hashes and test-only independent formulas. No original PEFR row arrays or paper figures are distributed. Local-only external clinical outputs may not be uploaded.

Display-only shared Bland-Altman bias/95-percent population limits/pointwise CIs/optional prespecified bounds; shared count contingency heatmap with row denominators. Dataset name required. Native render, original-anchor execution and real owner adapter/contact sheet remain pending.
